follow-up time: Not clearly stated, but data collected on course of pregnancy, newborn outcomes, and maternal survival up to a mean of 8.2 years after transplantation and 4.6 years after pregnancy
cohort: 35 women aged >20 years who underwent lung or heart-lung transplantation and subsequently experienced 39 pregnancies
finding: Pregnancy remains feasible in lung and heart-lung transplant recipients, with more frequent maternal and newborn complications than in the general population.
gest_age: mean gestational age at birth was 36 weeks
